title: Vertical Order Traversal of a Binary Tree
description: Traverse a binary tree and return the node values in vertical order, sorted by column, then row, then value.
pseudocode:
1. map = new Map()
2. queue = [{node: root, col: 0, row: 0}]
3. while queue not empty:
4.   {node, col, row} = queue.shift()
5.   if (!map.has(col)) map.set(col, [])
6.   map.get(col).push({row, val: node.val})
7.   if (node.left) queue.push({node: node.left, col: col-1, row: row+1})
8.   if (node.right) queue.push({node: node.right, col: col+1, row: row+1})
9. sort map columns and sort entries by row then val

steps.note: Initialize queue with root node at (col 0, row 0)
Push left child 9 to queue at col -1
Push right child 20 to queue at col 1
Push left child 15 of node 20 to queue at col 0
Push right child 7 of node 20 to queue at col 2
